note: x_search accepts at most 20 handles per allowed_x_handles call, and allowed/excluded are mutually exclusive. Lanes are split so each stays under the cap and keeps a single search intent.

cadence.note: JD's brainstorm cadence. x_search bills ~$5/1k calls, so 5 runs x ~9 lanes is a few dollars a month.

xLanes.label: JD's permanent account watchlist
xLanes.query: Companies growing their New York City team, opening or expanding a NYC office, hiring in New York, or announcing funding that will fund NYC headcount

xLanes.label: NYC tech press
xLanes.query: New York City company office expansion, headquarters move, new Manhattan office, NYC team growth, or funding round

xLanes.label: Open founder chatter
xLanes.query: Founders and operators posting that their New York City team outgrew its office, that they are leaving coworking or WeWork for their own space, that they are opening a NYC office, moving from remote to in-person or hybrid, hiring a Head of Workplace or Facilities, or hitting a headcount milestone of 20, 50, or 100 people

xLanes.label: Growth and scale language
xLanes.query: Companies saying they doubled or tripled headcount, are scaling their NYC presence, just made a senior New York hire (VP, Head of, CRO, COO, Chief of Staff), grew ARR sharply, or reached a new valuation

xLanes.label: NYC commercial real estate chatter
xLanes.query: Manhattan office lease signed, tenant seeking space, sublease listed, or NYC office market tenant demand

webLanes.label: NYC team growth — the highest-weighted signal
webLanes.query: companies with a growing New York City team, dozens of open NYC roles, expanding their New York engineering or sales office

webLanes.label: NYC office moves and expansions
webLanes.query: company opening new New York City office OR relocating headquarters to Manhattan OR expanding NYC office space OR outgrowing its current New York office OR leaving coworking for dedicated space

webLanes.label: Workplace and facilities leadership hires
webLanes.query: company hired Head of Workplace OR Director of Workplace Experience OR Head of Facilities OR Office Manager in New York City

webLanes.label: NYC funding — a timing signal, not a fit signal
webLanes.query: New York City headquartered startup raised Series A, Series B, or Series C, or announced a new valuation or sharp ARR growth, in the last 14 days
